hook: Iran aims 6 drones at a US radar

slides.title: Iran targets Bahrain again
slides.image_prompt: Radar dish on a desert air base at dusk, small drone silhouettes in an orange sky, a grey aircraft carrier on the sea horizon
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran aimed 6 drones at a US radar; Bahrain intercepted.
WHY IT MATTERS
2nd attack in 3 days; 3rd US carrier reportedly arrives.
FOR YOU
Tension is rising again in the Gulf, a key route for the world's oil.
slides.body: Iran aimed 6 drones at a US radar; Bahrain intercepted. 2nd attack in 3 days; 3rd US carrier reportedly arrives. Tension is rising again in the Gulf, a key route for the world's oil.
slides.credit: Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Ricardo R. Guzman/U.S. Navy (Public domain) via wikimedia

slides.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round table in a modern conference hall, a city skyline glowing through tall windows
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The three leaders meet Thursday in Shenzhen, China, at APEC.
WHY IT MATTERS
First-ever three-way talks; Trump wants nuclear arsenal cuts.
FOR YOU
Talks on cutting nuclear weapons could follow, but nothing is agreed yet.
slides.body: The three leaders meet Thursday in Shenzhen, China, at APEC. First-ever three-way talks; Trump wants nuclear arsenal cuts. Talks on cutting nuclear weapons could follow, but nothing is agreed yet.

slides.title: Ukraine's record drone attack
slides.image_prompt: Long road and rail bridge over a dark sea at night, a swarm of small drone silhouettes crossing the sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia says it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight.
WHY IT MATTERS
By Russia's count, the war's biggest Ukrainian drone attack.
FOR YOU
Nothing changes for you directly, but the drone war keeps escalating.
slides.body: Russia says it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight. By Russia's count, the war's biggest Ukrainian drone attack. Nothing changes for you directly, but the drone war keeps escalating.

slides.title: COP31 drafts a climate deal
slides.image_prompt: A globe on a negotiating table beside a power plug and a lump of coal, Mediterranean coastline in the background
slides.label: SCIENCE
points: WHAT HAPPENED
COP31 in Turkey published its first draft deal on Monday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Nearly 200 nations must sign off; fossil fuels still divide.
FOR YOU
It includes a goal: electricity at 35% of energy use by 2035.
slides.body: COP31 in Turkey published its first draft deal on Monday. Nearly 200 nations must sign off; fossil fuels still divide. It includes a goal: electricity at 35% of energy use by 2035.

slides.title: England stun Spain 3-2
slides.image_prompt: A football resting in a bulging goal net inside a floodlit stadium at night, green grass glowing under the lights
slides.label: SPORT
points: WHAT HAPPENED
England beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid.
WHY IT MATTERS
It ended Spain's record 43-match unbeaten run.
FOR YOU
England top their Nations League group; Kane, Konsa and White scored.
slides.body: England beat world champions Spain 3-2 in Madrid. It ended Spain's record 43-match unbeaten run. England top their Nations League group; Kane, Konsa and White scored.

caption:
🇧🇭 Iran says it aimed 6 drones at a US radar in Bahrain; a 3rd US carrier reportedly arrived.
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin meet Thursday in Shenzhen, with nuclear arms cuts on Trump's list.
🛸 Russia says it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, a war record by its count.
🌍 COP31's first draft deal is out: it could shape energy rules, including 35% electricity by 2035.
⚽ England beat Spain 3-2, ending their 43-match unbeaten run.
